messages.author: 1e477181b84961d1
messages.subject: ggplot title centring problem
parts:
Hi all,

I've noticed that plot titles in ggplot are not being centred at the top of the plot. I'm using ggplot 2.2.0; R 3.3.2; Windows 7 SP1.

For example:

ggplot(cars, aes(x = speed, y = dist))+
geom_point()+
ggtitle("cars title")

OR

ggplot(cars, aes(x = speed, y = dist))+
geom_point()+
labs(title = "cars title")

(result is the same)



Is this a known bug in the current version? What would people recommend as the best work around to centre plot titles.

Cheers,
Liam
